card.name: Words leading up to 'establishment' (brothels, venues)
card.fires_on: Words just before a noun like 'establishment' or 'quarter' in passages about prostitution, brothels, licensed districts and shut-down venues. It marks the spot where a word for a venue or business is expected next.

modes.label: Licensed districts
modes.description: Words in phrases about where prostitution was confined or licensed, such as 'licensed' or 'in special' before 'sections' or 'quarter'.
modes.example: Yoshiwara: name of the<< licensed>> quarter in Edo.

modes.label: Running or closing venues
modes.description: Verbs before a business noun, such as running laundries or closing down casinos and night clubs.
modes.example: passed laws to close<< down>> casinos and night clubs.
